content:
Let \(T\) be the top vertex, let \(B\) and \(C\) be the lower-left and lower-right vertices, and let \(M\) be the marked midpoint of edge \(AT\).

The shaded plane \(MBC\) cuts the tetrahedron into two tetrahedra. The part containing \(A\) is tetrahedron \(ABCM\).

Compare tetrahedra \(ABCM\) and \(ABCT\). They have the same base \(\triangle ABC\). Since \(M\) is the midpoint of \(AT\), its height above the plane of \(\triangle ABC\) is half the height of \(T\). Therefore,
\[
\frac{V_{ABCM}}{V_{ABCT}}=\frac12.
\]
Thus the required volume is
\[
\frac12(216)=\boxed{108}.
\]
